intent: A newsroom explainer: brisk, exact dates, one surprise per sentence.
pacing_profile: question read verbatim, three options, 3-s beat, reveal with the number, story beats shaped per episode (brief.md), punchline + short follow
pause_policy: Pause only at the marked ellipses; the beat is real silence (ticks come from quizscore.py).
title: Which of these joined the United Nations MOST recently?

lines.direction: the question, cold — curiosity comes from the map moving under it
lines.text: Which of these joined the United Nations most recently?

lines.direction: quick, each option its own beat

lines.text: South Sudan. It became member number 193 on 14 July 2011, days after independence.

lines.direction: the second-newest lights up: camera glides north, Montenegro fills, pin drops, the year card lands on 'vote'
lines.text: Montenegro joined in June 2006, just a month after its own independence vote.

lines.direction: the surprise: Switzerland fills, the country pulses on 'only', the ballot-box sticker pops on 'referendum', year card
lines.text: And Switzerland, neutral since 1815, only joined in 2002, after a nationwide referendum.

lines.direction: pull back to the whole map, the member counter runs 51 → 193, then the independence-day photograph rises out of South Sudan on 'since'
lines.text: 193 members today, and nobody at all has joined since South Sudan.

lines.direction: punchline, then a short follow — the outro visual asks
lines.text: The youngest flag in the room. Follow us.
